title: Base is shifted upward, causing negative ground clearance
evidence: rounded_box(center=true) centres only X/Y and starts at Z=0. Additional BASE_T/2 makes base Z=2..6. Wheel bottom=26.5−22.5=4; underside is 2 mm below wheel ground plane.
required_change: Place base at Z=0..4; choose ground clearance e.g. 5–8 mm and compute shaft Z = wheel radius − clearance with base datum 0. Rebuild motor/deck constraints together.

title: Base mounting holes are blind
evidence: Hole cutter Z=−1..5; base Z=2..6 leaves a 1 mm roof.
required_change: Normalize base origin and use cuts extending past both faces.

title: Base cable slots cut only lower face
evidence: Centred height-6 cube translated Z=−1 gives −4..2; base begins at 2, so only coplanar contact, no useful through slot.
required_change: Use a full-thickness slot cutter centred at true base midpoint plus epsilon.

title: Battery tray is a bottomless ring
evidence: Tray Z=0..7; centred void translated Z=3 has Z=−1..7, removing the entire floor.
required_change: Add 2–3 mm floor, height matching pack, retaining lips, two strap slots and cable exit.

title: Tray screw holes occupy cavity instead of proper mounting tabs
evidence: Hole centres ±29/±15 are inside 62×32 opening (±31/±16), cutting only edge fragments.
required_change: Add tabs outside battery cavity with bolt-head/nut clearance; choose holes shared by chassis.

title: Standoffs miss the deck and base holes
evidence: Standoffs Z=4..36; deck underside=38, so 2 mm gap. Their XY ±50/±30 do not match base grid ±60/±30/0 × ±35/0.
required_change: Tie four base/deck holes to one shared array and derive spacer length from mating surfaces.

title: Deck centre opening leaves a roof
evidence: Centred height-5 cutter at Z=37 reaches only Z=39.5; deck Z=38..41 leaves 1.5 mm roof.
required_change: Cut through Z=38..41 plus epsilon; add protected wire edges.

title: Wheels overlap chassis sides
evidence: Wheel tyre inner Y=58.5−7=51.5, base edge=52.5, giving 1 mm lateral intrusion. At wheel low arc Z=4..6 this is physical solid intersection.
required_change: Position wheel from motor shaft engagement/offset and ≥1–2 mm assembled moving clearance, then re-check entire rotation.

title: Gearbox intersects wheel hub and shaft engagement is incomplete
evidence: Right motor centre Y=42.5; gearbox Y=55..61. Wheel centre=58.5, integral hub Y=50.5..66.5 with Ø3.2 bore. Ø12 gearbox occupies that hub bore region. Shaft Y=61..69 gives only 5.5 mm engagement within 16 mm integral hub.
required_change: Use exact motor face-to-shaft dimensions and actual bought wheel hub depth; resolve gearbox/hub collision before print.

classification: Motor fit risk; exact profile unverified
title: N20 cavity models a cylinder instead of rectangular motor
evidence: N20_BODY_H=10 is unused. 12×10 rectangular body diagonal is 15.62 mm; largest cylindrical cavity is Ø13.5. A full rectangular envelope cannot fit; actual rounded-can fit needs measurement.
required_change: Model rounded rectangular can/gearbox profiles, tolerances and retaining clamp from measured motor.

title: Mount insertion cut is asymmetric on the wrong local axis
evidence: Cut cube spans X=−16..0, Y=−22..0; every mount uses same transform, despite comment saying mirror for opposite side.
required_change: Design insertion access in shaft-side/inward direction, explicitly mirror/clamp left and right variants.

title: Motor mounts have no working chassis fastening/retention
evidence: Two local screws ±10 map to X=±42/±62,Y=±42.5; base grid has neither. Cutter stops Z=10 in mount Z=4..29; no defined accessible screw head/nut or motor clamp.
required_change: Add foot/flange, shared base holes, head/nut pockets, clamp screws and cable clearance.

title: Wheel adapter splits into two disconnected halves
evidence: Full-height 1.2 mm slot crosses entire hub diameter. Axial holes at X=±5 do not join the halves radially; wheel has no matching bolt holes or adapter pocket.
required_change: Prefer purchased D-shaft wheel; otherwise closed slotted clamp with cross bolt and wheel bolt/pocket interface.

title: Round bore has no torque lock
evidence: Ø3.2 wheel / Ø3.25 adapter on Ø3 D shaft has no D flat, radial set screw or designed interference; adapter omitted from assembly.
required_change: Use D-shaped bore or metal clamping hub and axial retention; do not assume loose round bore transmits torque.

title: Bumper is detached and projects into wheel envelope
evidence: Bumper Y=−61.5..−53.5 versus base minimum Y=−52.5 gives 1 mm gap. Its X width overlaps side wheel positions at the bumper Z span.
required_change: Move actual front to chassis X end, add bolt tabs and swept wheel clearance; evaluate TPU option.

title: Sensors/bumper labelled front are on lateral edge
evidence: Length/front-rear declared X, wheel shafts along Y, so rolling direction is ±X. Camera/ToF/bumper are on −Y (left/right side).
required_change: Adopt one axis convention and move/aim front sensors at −X or redefine all drivetrain coordinates consistently.

title: Camera fixture floats and orientation is unresolved
evidence: camera_mount bottom Z=42; deck top=41 gives 1 mm gap. Horizontal 36×24 slot fixture is not actual camera PCB pattern; camera_front_mount exists but is never called.
required_change: Use camera-specific forward bracket with shared holes, adjustment, lens opening and ribbon/connector clearance.

title: ESP tray fastening pattern does not match deck
evidence: Tray holes translate to X=−1/45,Y=0/24; deck has only four ±50/±30 holes and partial centre opening. Tray rests on deck without fasteners.
required_change: Add carrier mounting holes independent from actual board holes and model underside solder/header clearance.

title: ToF bar has circular apertures but no PCB interface
evidence: Three Ø8 holes along Z do not define forward pointing PCBs; no breakout dimensions, M2 holes, left/right angle or chassis tab matches.
required_change: Create three named angled PCB brackets from selected sensor drawings; keep optics clear of printed walls.

title: Battery tray height depends on erroneous base datum
evidence: Current tray bottom Z=6 touches erroneous base top=6, but holes do not match; if base-origin fix is made alone it introduces a 2 mm gap. Capacity/type dimensions absent.
required_change: Constrain tray bottom to corrected base top, fit exact pack including connector and straps; do not change only one Z constant.

title: Wheel tread comment and production thickness disagree
evidence: Comment says six grooves; loop 0:30:330 creates twelve. WHEEL_W=14 versus design document 12; deck 38 versus document 42–45.
required_change: Use one dimensional source and update prose/counts; design tread/material against actual tyre.

title: Individual exports retain assembly Z transforms
evidence: top_cover exports at Z=38, bumper at Z=10; wheels/hub span negative Z; standoffs export four positioned parts.
required_change: Separate local printable geometry from placement transforms; normalise each printable part to Z≥0 and document copies.

title: Crossmembers do not cross the chassis
evidence: Both 250×24 members have length along X and are at Y=±55. Rails lie at ±125. Crossmember Y edge=67; rail inner edge=111 leaves 44 mm gap.
required_change: Rotate crossmembers 90° about Z, place at selected X positions, create four joints and matched holes/angle brackets.

title: Motors, motor plates, hubs and bearings absent from assembly
evidence: assembly calls only wheels. motor_mount, motor_placeholder, wheel_hub and wheel_bearing_block are defined but unused. Wheels have no physical connection to frame.
required_change: Add four measured motors, face planes, brackets, hubs, shafts and fixation; model optional bearing supports only if actually used.

title: 37D hole circle is wrong
evidence: Six 60° holes at R=17.9 create 17.9 mm neighbour spacing. Stated reference is 15.5 mm neighbours / Ø31 circle, so R must be 15.5. MOTOR_HOLE_NEIGHBOR unused.
required_change: Use purchased-motor measured PCD/offset/pattern, not generic equivalence; for published Pololu drawing set R=15.5 and correct plate opening.

title: Correcting hole circle alone breaks screw seats
evidence: Current central opening radius=15; corrected M3 clearance radius 1.7 around R=15.5 extends inward to 13.8, overlapping opening by 1.2 mm.
required_change: Reduce opening to actual shaft/pilot-boss clearance with adequate material around each screw and washer; check reference pilot dimensions.

title: Motor plate has no suitable frame foot/orientation
evidence: Plate is local XY, normal Z, but wheel shafts are Y. No L foot, rotated location or chassis mating pattern.
required_change: Use metal L-bracket with vertical face normal Y, finite foot and matched frame holes; reserve screw-tool access.

title: Wheel intersects rails and bumpers
evidence: Wheel Y=134..166 overlaps side rail Y=111..139 by 5 mm; at X near ±150,Z=0..24 wheel solid crosses rail. Bumpers Y=±138..162,Z=20..48 overlap wheels too.
required_change: Increase track from actual frame/shaft/hub/tyre offsets or cut/reposition members; add dynamic clearances and redefine front bumpers at X ends.

title: Zero frame underside ground clearance
evidence: Rails start Z=0; wheel bottom=50−50=0. Structure sits on ground plane.
required_change: Specify ≥20–30 mm provisional clearance for this terrain aim and tie rail/motor locations to it; validate payload/load and actual obstacle height.

title: Declared structural footprint is not model-controlled
evidence: BASE_L=360, BASE_W=290 and BASE_T=5 are unused. Rail length 330, outer width 278; bumpers to Y±162; wheels span X±200,Y±166.
required_change: Derive member lengths, wheelbase, track and bumper positions from parameters; label structural footprint separately from 400×332 overall envelope.

title: Battery tray has a roof rather than an open top
evidence: Tray local Z=0..12; centred void Z=−8..8 removes bottom to 8, leaving top slab Z=8..12. Battery cannot drop into it from above.
required_change: Start cavity above a solid floor and cut out past top; resize exact battery, add straps, lips and tabs.

title: Battery mounting holes are in roof over cavity
evidence: Centres ±95/±35 lie inside cavity ±100/±40 and drill roof. No deck/shared frame bolt pattern or battery restraint.
required_change: Place mounting tabs outside cavity, grounded to supported deck; keep fasteners clear of cell casing.

title: Electronics and compute decks have no supports
evidence: Electronics bottom=35 vs rails top=24 gives 11 mm gap. Battery bottom=48 vs electronics top=43 gives 5 mm gap. Pi/ESP mounts bottom=60 with no defined supported connection.
required_change: Add posts at matching holes and explicit load path; put heavy battery low, compute above with airflow and service access.

title: Electronics cable channels remain capped
evidence: Height-12 centred cube at Z=−1 reaches Z=5; tray thickness=8 leaves 3 mm roof.
required_change: Make real through channels with grommet/strain relief or label intentionally blind channels and route accordingly.

title: Pi ventilation opening remains capped
evidence: Same centred cube reaches Z=5 in 8 mm plate, leaving 3 mm plastic over supposed opening.
required_change: Through cut and validate Pi underside clearance, airflow, cooler and connector access.

title: LiDAR mast is above and detached from plate
evidence: Plate Z=105..113; mast Z=160..280 gives 47 mm gap above plate rather than support beneath it. Plate itself unsupported.
required_change: Use short mast between supported deck and plate; model upper/lower flanges, hole patterns, cable exit and torsional restraint.

title: LiDAR cable bore is blind for almost half its height
evidence: Centred 125 mm bore at Z=−1 extends −63.5..61.5 in 120 mm mast, leaving top 58.5 mm solid. Screw holes reach only Z=19.
required_change: Bore full height plus epsilon and add upper fastening/cable relief; eliminate dangling mast until chosen sensor needs one.

title: Wheel hub cannot lock onto D shaft
evidence: Ø6.15 round bore on 6 mm D shaft, no D flat, radial screw or clamp; hub 20 mm long may exceed Pololu 16 mm shaft after plate loss.
required_change: Metal clamping hub matched to shaft and chosen wheel; budget shaft engagement, motor face plate and bearing spacing.

title: Wheel has no hub fastening pattern
evidence: Hub has four M4 holes on radius 15 at 45/135/225/315°, wheel only has Ø6.2 bore. No pockets/holes/axial retention marry them.
required_change: Add matching wheel holes/nut recesses or buy wheel+hub kit; locate clamping screw and verify all fasteners accessible.

title: Bearing cavity has no compatible shaft or retention design
evidence: 22 mm OD cavity suggests 608 bearing (8 mm ID), whereas shaft is 6 mm. 16 mm-deep open bore has no shoulder/cap/fit tolerance.
required_change: If support needed, use chosen 6 mm-ID bearing such as 626 with changed OD19 seat, retain both races appropriately and provide axle/collar/alignment.

title: Rounded side panel violates its requested width
evidence: rounded_box 330×5 with r=5 requires at least 10 mm width, but centres at Y±2.5 produce overall width15 mm. Horizontal holes are centred Z=0, creating half holes at bottom.
required_change: Assert 2r≤min(x,y), reduce radius or use true thin panel geometry; move hole centres above edge with proper mounting tabs.

title: Camera/ToF and front bumpers on side, without mating tabs
evidence: Wheel axes Y mean driving X. Sensors at Y=−155/−160 and bumper Y=±150 are lateral; no actual PCB interfaces/support.
required_change: Move forward sensors to X end, add angled bracket patterns for exact boards and defined frame attachment.

title: Pi hole spacing correct but fastener/board interface incomplete
evidence: 58×49 nominal grid is plausible, but clearance uses M3=3.4; actual Pi board uses M2.5-compatible mounting. Board outline, hole offset, solder, cooler/cables not modelled.
required_change: Use manufacturer mechanical drawing, M2.5 spacers, real board offset and port cable clearance; mount never rests PCB on solid plate.

title: LiDAR grid is not a sensor-specific mount
evidence: 110×110 generic grid offers no chosen scanner mounting pattern, connector envelope or scan-plane clearance. Mast, battery/compute volumes omitted.
required_change: Pick scanner kit, import mechanical drawing, keep 360° optical plane unoccluded and vibration restrained.

title: SCAD solid rails differ from intended aluminium construction
evidence: 330×28×24 solid bars with vertical holes are not 2020 extrusion or angle profiles; no T-nuts, joints or cut/drill drawing.
required_change: Create actual metal frame drawings/BOM with section/material and connection hardware; do not simply print bars and assume rugged strength.

title: Motor placeholder does not establish a purchased-motor envelope
evidence: Centred 65 mm cylinder plus partly overlapping 26.5 mm face and Ø6 shaft is illustrative; shaft offset, encoder and wire exits unmodelled. JGB37 and Pololu references differ.
required_change: Choose exact motor SKU, body/gearbox/encoder length, face pilot, eccentricity and harness envelope; do not mix motor families.

title: Compact STL is stale relative to current source
evidence: Existing bounds X −77.4263..150, Y −67.5..105, Z 0..48.9263; extents 227.4263×172.5×48.9263. Current source X envelope −75..75; tyres/hubs Y about −66.5..66.5, motor placeholder shafts extend to ±69. File mtime also older.
required_change: Archive existing STL as an unreleased historical artefact; regenerate separate parts only after corrected CAD is checked.

title: Existing STL has a nonmanifold edge
evidence: One edge from (−10,−16,24) to (10,−16,24) has four incident faces. No boundary edges; five vertex-connected components.
required_change: Fix source tangency/union responsible in original source if available; regenerated part meshes must have exactly two incident faces per edge.

title: Manufacturing exports incomplete
evidence: Only one STL exists, for old complete compact assembly. No rugged STL and no per-part STLs; assembly exports include nonprinted placeholders/unjoined/fused geometry.
required_change: Release explicit named part STLs/3MF, quantity/orientation table, source hash and dimensions; never print motor placeholders.

title: Concept images referenced by documents are missing
evidence: compact_rover_top.svg and rugged_rover_top.svg do not exist; images/ at repository root is empty. Existing assembled PNG is a preview, not proof of fit.
required_change: Replace missing references with real current-source renders after CAD fixes and retain diagnostic drawings clearly labelled.

title: No complete electrical or pin assignment design
evidence: No schematic, selected board pin map, driver mounting, XSHUT/encoder level interface, wire routing or switch/power mounts in CAD.
required_change: Freeze hardware pin plan, supply branches, harness and failure-stop logic; list mounts for every purchased board.

classification: Likely documentation error; seller confirmation needed
title: Encoder “11-wire” claim appears to confuse pulse count with conductors
evidence: Rugged document calls the motor 11-wire. Manufacturer JGB37 example says 11 signals per motor revolution and shows six signal/power leads; selected listing live read blocked.
required_change: Delete blanket 11-wire assumption; require purchased motor pinout. Establish PPR vs quadrature counts and gear ratio experimentally.

title: 6 V N20 power baseline and driver peak rating are unresolved
evidence: Compact document proposes 2S battery straight into drivers; full charge is 8.4 V vs recommended 6 V motor. DRV8833 RMS differs by package and board cooling.
required_change: Use regulated motor rail with transient handling, or exact motor rated for selected rail; verify stall and current protection.

title: Original rugged battery can overvolt a 12 V motor
evidence: 4S LFP approaches 14.6 V, ~22% above 12 V. Motor tolerance not established; brake regeneration and BMS trips unanalysed.
required_change: Verify motor permitted voltage or use suitable regulation/voltage selection. PWM duty reduction limits average drive but does not remove higher terminal pulses.

title: Rugged terrain/payload goals have no quantified validation
evidence: No total mass, centre of gravity, slope target, traction coefficient, radial motor load or suspension/articulation calculation. A rigid four-wheel chassis can lose contact on uneven ground.
required_change: Set mass/slope/obstacle targets, model motor torque/load and tipping limits; test progressively. Treat terrain claims as targets, not verified capability.

title: BOM baseline omits practical integration purchases
evidence: No fixed camera programmer, Pi5-specific cable, level conversion, pack restraint, connectors/contact counts, regulator transients or exact hardware lengths.
required_change: Use revised BOM plus optional inventory below; fastener lengths remain conditional on corrected joints.

title: No print fit/tolerance or fabrication acceptance criteria
evidence: No printer clearances for shafts/bearing seats/heat-set inserts; no metal plate drawings/load tests. $fn segmentation is adequate for visuals, not proof of shaft fit.
required_change: Print bore/hole coupons, measure real motor/wheel, inspect F6 part mesh and slicer; record acceptance before full prints.

title: Legacy Pololu reference is discontinued
evidence: Research references #2826; manufacturer now marks obsolete and points to #4755, which is 100 RPM, not budget JGB 60 RPM.
required_change: Update documentation and differentiate reference drawing from recommended purchasable SKU.
